verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's official MCP server lets AI assistants operate the platform from natural-language requests: searching docs, initializing projects, managing projects and orgs, triggering tasks, deploying to environments and monitoring runs. Skills teach coding assistants how to use the product. Natural-language operation depends on an external AI client, and there is no hands-on account of it working. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the dashboard or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation via MCP.
